posts.text: FYI: The National Guard deployed in D.C. have Court Services and Offender Supervision Agency employees walking around the streets of D.C. with them tonight. There were more CSOSA-identified people in a big group on U Street than National Guard.

posts.text: BREAKING: Judge Failla denies DOJ’s stay request in the NYC/NYU Langone case, using strong language stating that DOJ is seeking “a complete subversion of the Court’s decision to grant the preliminary injunction in the first place. … This the Court will not do.”
posts.summary: Reports judge rejects DOJ stay request in gender-affirming care case
posts.quote: BREAKING: Judge Failla denies DOJ’s stay request in the NYC/NYU Langone case, using strong language stating that DOJ is seeking “a complete subversion of the Court’s decision to grant the preliminary injunction in the first place. … This the Court will not do.”

posts.text: NOTE: No changes, but just want to note that in addition to filing notices of appeal in the NYC/NYU Langone and Packard (Stanford) cases over DOJ's grand jury subpoenas relating to gender-affirming care for trans minors, DOJ has filed motions at the district courts to stay the injunctions.
